location.mapHint: Drag the marker or click the map to set the site. Coordinates sync with the fields below.
location.countryUnavailable: Country defaults are unavailable right now.
location.confirmOverride: Applying country defaults will overwrite your edited discount rate and grid emission factor. Continue?

general.constantsNote: Engine constants: desalination {desal} kWh/m³ · pumping {pump} kWh/m³ per 100 m · water use {water} L/kg H₂

supply.atLeastOne: Enable at least one electricity source
supply.coupledOn: Linked to electrolyzer capacity — click to unlink
supply.coupledOff: Unlinked — click to link to electrolyzer capacity

help.lat: Site latitude in decimal degrees (−90 to 90). Determines the solar and wind resource profiles.
help.lon: Site longitude in decimal degrees (−180 to 180). Determines the solar and wind resource profiles.
help.lifetime: Project lifetime in years over which costs and production are discounted.
help.discount: Discount rate (WACC) applied to future costs and hydrogen output.
help.waterPrice: Delivered water price at the point of use.
help.waterTransport: Transport cost per m³ of water per 100 km of distance.
help.transportDistance: Distance the water is transported to the site.
help.desalinated: Counts desalination electricity in the emissions ledger only — never in cost.
help.pumpingHead: Water pumping lift in metres. Emissions ledger only.
help.capacity: Electrolyzer nameplate capacity at the system boundary (electrolyzer outlet).
help.efficiency: Average system efficiency on LHV basis, including balance of plant.
help.capex: Installed electrolyzer capital cost per kW.
help.opex: Fixed annual operating cost as a share of electrolyzer CAPEX.
help.stackLifetime: Operating hours before a stack replacement is required.
help.stackReplacement: Cost of each stack replacement as a share of electrolyzer CAPEX.
help.degradation: Annual efficiency degradation of the stack.
help.pvKind: PV array mounting: fixed at optimal tilt, or single- or dual-axis tracking.
help.windKind: Reference 5.6 MW turbine at 120 m or 160 m hub height. Capacity scales linearly.
help.lcoe: Fixed price paid per MWh consumed from this source.
help.sourceCapex: Installed capital cost of the plant per kW. The engine derives an LCOE from CAPEX and OPEX.
help.sourceOpex: Annual operating cost as a share of plant CAPEX.
help.plantSize: Installed plant capacity. Linked to the electrolyzer capacity until you edit it.
help.gridPrice: Price paid per MWh imported from the grid or PPA.
help.gridMax: Maximum power drawn from the grid in any hour. Linked to the electrolyzer capacity until you edit it.
help.gridEf: Grid emission factor in tCO₂ per MWh. Use the country defaults selector for a suggestion.

run.invalid: Fix the highlighted fields to calculate
